angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill burst, year-standardized, followed drill -> NFL bend / NGS get-off -> career pressure rate; baselines = pick only, pick + role, and the full no-tracking model (log pick, weight, EDGE share, NGS score, official 10-yd split, 3-cone) by OLS and by ridge, leave-one-class-out; six pre-listed drill measures tested jointly; drill-rep reliability as the evidence base for a four-lap protocol; day-3 use reduced to film order; 2026 player cards
metric_name: Hoop G: how hard a lineman leans into the tightest half-second of the Run-the-Hoop figure-eight (speed squared / turn radius, in g; median 7.1 mph on a 1.8-yd radius = 0.62 g), z within Combine year
headline_number: Held out (n=77): Hoop G +1.8 pressures per 450-rush season per sd [0.2, 3.4], family-wise p=0.23 across six drill measures; ridge-residual 2.1, IPW 1.9, independent verify.py 2.4. R2 gain over pick + role 0.06 [-0.10, 0.20], over ridge baseline 0.04 [-0.07, 0.17]. One hoop lap reliability 0.43 [0.21, 0.58] (left vs right turn, n=109); 4 laps reach 0.70; burst one rep 0.13, needs 16. Of 26 tests, only the NFL trait -> pressure links survive Holm at 0.10.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round 21 cand_1 (8.24), applying the round 21 judges' cross-angle top_changes: (1) in-text drill-rep vs NFL-rep comparison in coach units (g, mph, turn radius) with a one-line coach read for each of the four hero rushers, and a coach-language Hoop G definition; (2) evidence base for the rep prescription: new Fig 2 with Spearman-Brown reliability vs reps, bootstrap bands, and a well-powered internal check (left-hand vs right-hand turn of the same lap, n=109) alongside the 10-lineman lap-to-lap ICC, giving a four-lap protocol and dropping burst reps; (3) shrunken and simpler baselines: pick only, pick + role (+ Hoop G), ridge no-tracking baseline with penalty chosen inside training classes, RMSE units and outcome sd stated; (4) multiplicity across all 26 reported tests with BH and Holm at 0.10 (multiplicity.csv); (5) the day-3 section cut to a decisive three-sentence 'film list, not a ranking' note, its figure removed; (6) 40-clip offset and injury/missed-time handling stated in Limitations; (7) ends on a single scout action; card text at 10 pt+ with shortened splits; Fig 3 (reliability) layout without collisions.
open_risks: Headline remains a null after the six-measure correction (family-wise p=0.23) and fails BH/Holm across 26 tests; the action is film order only

The four-lap prescription is a Spearman-Brown projection from one-lap reliability (turn-split 0.43 [0.21, 0.58]; lap-to-lap 0.37 on only 10 linemen, which implies five laps), not an observed multi-lap result
Left- and right-hand turns may measure partly different skills (handedness), so the turn-split can understate lap reliability
verify.py slope (2.4) differs from the main estimate (1.8) by about a third, mostly via imputation choice
The +20-point board bar for day 3 was set after round 20 had already seen the result, so it is not a pre-registration
Coach reads for the four hero rushers are interpretations of drill-vs-NFL numbers on 16-19 sampled rushes each, not scheme-specific evaluations
33 linemen with under 30 career rushes are excluded and not reweighted
